name: 09-settings-processing
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality UI concept board for Uni Companion, university-only React Native Android course study and discussion app. TWO full portrait app screens side-by-side, edge to edge, crisp readable text, minimal neutral gutter, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside marketing captions. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its cobalt blue primary, white surfaces, navy ink, rounded bold sans-serif headings, readable regular body, tactile rounded buttons with shallow dark-blue bottom edge, icon weight, and original orange star mascot with expressive navy eyes, short arms, cobalt sneakers. Draw new screen layouts. Original art direction, playful consumer quality like Duolingo, not a copy. Clean Android safe areas, generous tap targets, disciplined whitespace, moderate heading sizes. No serif, no cream/forest-green styling, no decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no fake provider logos. Mascot small and purposeful except welcome, never repeated on same screen. Use fictional sample data. LEFT SETTINGS: back heading 'Settings', groups with clear row controls: Account with Edit profile, Change password; Preferences with Appearance set System, Study reminders set Off with switch; Community with Blocked accounts and Community guidelines; Privacy with 'About anonymous posting'; Help with Contact support. Separate clear 'Log out' and restrained red 'Delete account' at bottom. Consistent blue accent, no mascot or decoration in utilitarian settings. RIGHT MATERIAL PROCESSING STATE: back 'Course material', title 'Getting your notes ready.', one orange star organizing little blue pages, selected file Normalization.pdf CSC 301. A truthful stepped status list 'Upload complete' checked, 'Reading document' active with subtle indicator, 'Preparing study tools' pending. No fabricated percentage or countdown. Text 'You can leave this screen. We’ll keep the status here.' Bottom 'Back to course'. Small secondary 'Cancel processing' action. Status semantics legible beyond color; clear useful state of a real app.
